# SimplyApply

> SimplyApply is a free Chrome extension and job board that autofills job
> applications in one click, and aggregates open roles from Greenhouse,
> Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters, and other applicant tracking systems.

## What it does

- Autofills job application forms (name, experience, resume, answers to
  common screening questions) on company career pages and ATS-hosted
  application forms, using a profile you fill in once.
- Supports Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and SmartRecruiters application forms.
- Aggregates and searches open job postings across thousands of companies,
  refreshed daily, at https://www.simplyappl.ai/
- Lets signed-in users get a personalized "Recommended for you" job feed
  based on their stated preferences and application history.

## Key pages

- Homepage / job search: https://www.simplyappl.ai/
- Company job listings: https://www.simplyappl.ai/companies/{company-slug}
  (e.g. https://www.simplyappl.ai/companies/stripe)
- Privacy policy: https://www.simplyappl.ai/privacy
- Chrome extension: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/simplyapply-%E2%80%94-ai-job-auto/ocdeebjeffdjmfgmclnlphkhfdcdpdkf

## Who it's for

Job seekers applying to multiple roles who want to skip manually re-typing
the same application fields across Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, and
SmartRecruiters career sites.

## Pricing

Free.
